recommendations.explanation: gpt5_ocr most accurately captured the form fields and the handwritten notes (correct name, d/b/a, phone, most map bullets; only minor serial-code uncertainty). It preserved structure well. For a lower price, mistral delivers usable results with correct core form data and the email specs, but it introduces more spelling errors in the handwritten list (e.g., Bowens/Bowers, Waiter Wharf) and a wrong serial code, plus some formatting noise. Agentic_plus is close to gpt5_ocr in quality but costs much more.

Handwritten map—headings 'Proposed Routes' and 'Pedicab Stands/Pickup Points' incl. Parser-specific notes: • gpt5_ocr: strongest overall; clean structure; minor uncertainty markers; serial transcribed as 'MSPD D569' (likely wrong). • llamaparse_agentic_plus: very good accuracy; got 'Black 2008… MSPE D567'; a few list items misread ('Corner and Wharf', 'Water Wharf') and one instance of 'James E. Brown'. • llamaparse_agentic/auto: good form text but misread applicant middle initial as 'C'; map notes include errors ('Black dogs main Street Classic', inconsistent names). • mistral: correct applicant name; more typos in handwritten list ('Pedicato', 'Waiter Wharf') and wrong serial ('MSPC D867'); some extraneous image tags. • llamaparse_fast/cost_effective: multiple errors—year '2079', applicant initial 'C', signature read as 'AM', heavy garbling of handwritten notes; inserted 'NO_CONTENT_HERE'.
